recipes.label: Seven Steps to Slay the Seven-Coiled
recipes.startdescription:
As the book says, killing this powerful monster requires ample preparation; we must ensure the ritual's success.

[Please ensure you have at least five different sacred weapons on hand]

recipes.label: Seven Steps to Slay the Seven-Coiled
recipes.startdescription:
Everything is ready!

[Please ensure you have at least five different sacred weapons on hand]

recipes.label: The Serpent Falls
recipes.startdescription: The great mass crashes down, shaking the earth, dust surging like waves. It curls upon the ground as a silent long shadow, like a forgotten mountain range.

recipes.label: Ritual Interrupted!
recipes.startdescription: It has broken free from control – it will pour all its fury upon us!

recipes.label: Seventh Step
recipes.startdescription: The plume is the serpent's natural enemy – only it can deliver the final blow.

recipes.label: Seventh Step
recipes.startdescription: The power of finality pierces through the end. No sound, no aftermath of struggle – after a tremor as light as a sigh, it becomes an empty shell.

recipes.label: Sixth Step
recipes.startdescription: Dense, cold, hard scales cover its entire body; mortal weapons cannot even leave a shallow scratch.

recipes.label: Sixth Step
recipes.startdescription: With agility we dodge and leap, tearing open the serpent's belly scales, flesh and skin split apart.

recipes.label: Sixth Step
recipes.startdescription: Against worms, this weapon is professional – whether stabbing or slashing.

recipes.label: Sixth Step
recipes.startdescription: We forge the power of the military salute into a blade, piercing the thick scales.

recipes.label: Sixth Step
recipes.startdescription: With great force we hurl the javelin – a spear capable of piercing a Long's body tears through the thick scales.

recipes.label: Sixth Step
recipes.startdescription: This sword carries divine power meant for a king; its blade shines brilliantly, burning the corrupt essence of evil.

recipes.label: Third Step
recipes.startdescription: The coiled, writhing bulk of the Seven-Coiled piles layer upon layer, chaotic and indistinct, blocking every gap for advance.

recipes.label: Third Step
recipes.startdescription: The skull emits a frequency that restrains evil; the power of Heart vibrates the serpent's senses, dazing and disabling it.

recipes.label: Third Step
recipes.startdescription: The door-opener forges a path – unstoppable, indestructible.

recipes.label: Second Step
recipes.startdescription: The monster begins to shriek, and then little sisters gather to surround us.

recipes.label: Second Step
recipes.startdescription: Why use a sledgehammer to crack a nut?

recipes.label: Second Step
recipes.startdescription: I cleave through the tide of little sisters, cutting my way out of the sea of blood.

recipes.label: First Step
recipes.startdescription: The Seven-Coiled writhes, twisting and folding its grotesque patterns to display them to its enemy.

recipes.label: First Step
recipes.startdescription: I am blind; I fear no coiling.

recipes.label: Heavenly Messenger
recipes.startdescription: I hear some cheerful singing – those fellows must be above the clouds, or on the other side of dreams. Like worms, they are hard to detect, but fortunately they are on our side.
recipes.description: How unfeeling – they urge us to leave, the singing growing louder. It seems I won't be needed for the work ahead.

recipes.label: Touch the Corpse
recipes.startdescription: The great remains crumble to dust; perhaps it is because the cracks have been repaired. I have people collect them – after all, we cannot carry the monster's corpse with us.

recipes.label: Eradicate the Seven-Coiled's Corpse

recipes.startdescription: Sometimes, crushing restless enemies takes twice the effort.
recipes.description: They are dead – this time, they will not rise again.

recipes.label: Plan an Overwhelming Attack with Unpredictable Tactics
recipes.startdescription: Weaving through the shadows of the forest, dodging the scattered moonlight, we strike. Let them try to resist.

recipes.label: Plan an Overwhelming Attack with Relentless Tactics
recipes.startdescription: Certainty descends from above. Let them try to resist.

recipes.label: Plan an Overwhelming Attack with Unceasing Tactics
recipes.startdescription: Advance, advance – the beat of flesh urges us ever forward. Let them try to resist.

recipes.label: Plan an Overwhelming Attack with Specialised Weaponry
recipes.startdescription: Our guns will shake the earth and shear the mountaintops. Let them try to resist.

recipes.label: Plan an Overwhelming Attack with Dual Tactics
recipes.startdescription: Edge and Lantern are close comrades. Let them try to resist.

recipes.label: Plan an Overwhelming Attack with Dual Tactics

recipes.label: Plan an Overwhelming Attack with Dual Tactics
recipes.startdescription: Ear to the ground, nose to the air. We hunt like beasts, we strike like beasts. Let them try to resist.

recipes.label: Plan an Attack with Specialised Weaponry
recipes.startdescription: The talk is over. Now it's time for these tools to prove their worth.

recipes.label: Plan an Attack with Dual Tactics

recipes.label: Plan an Attack with Dual Tactics

[It will resume after leaving the current area]

recipes.label: Seventh Curse

Then one of our own suddenly collapses, burning with fever, in critical condition.

recipes.startdescription: The centre of my soul coincides with the centre of my flesh. My scars are my armour. I shall be untouched.

recipes.startdescription: Our great fist of steel and fire strikes back with force!

recipes.label: Witnessing the Coiling
recipes.startdescription: Those who witness the Coiling are destroyed by its strangeness...

recipes.label: Witnessing the Coiling
recipes.startdescription: A chill climbs up my back; words and symbols I cannot understand pierce through my brain. A deep-seated revulsion forces me to shut my eyes – but it's useless, the patterns have already penetrated my mind.

recipes.label: Remnant of the Seven-Coiled succeeds
recipes.startdescription: It greedily swallows the flesh and blood of our soldiers, and we are powerless.

recipes.label: Remnant of the Seven-Coiled succeeds
recipes.startdescription: It wreaks havoc on our supplies, and we are powerless.

recipes.label: Remnant of the Seven-Coiled succeeds
recipes.startdescription: It moves away, leaving devastation behind.

recipes.label: Use the Eye of the Blind to Weaken Enemies
recipes.startdescription: My eye is now winter; I can observe the weaknesses of these creatures in silence and stillness.

recipes.label: Make Me Blind
recipes.startdescription:
The maiden kisses my remaining good eye; a chill comes from my eye socket, and then I am fearless before the Seven-Coiled.

[You can only do this once per game; you will lose this ability when leaving the current warzone]

recipes.label: Make Me Blind?
recipes.startdescription:
I am not yet in such dire peril that I need to do this.

[This can only be done when you are in danger]

recipes.label: Divert from March Route
recipes.startdescription:
I will march to the wilderness of the wasteland – I have a mission.

[I can only proceed to the next location after dealing with the strangeness in the wasteland]

recipes.label: Examine the Statue
recipes.previewDescription: The maiden takes my hand, curious. I circle the statue with her, digging a small shadow between the base and the snow-mud – inside is a broken dagger. Below that, a piece of bone. I have disturbed the dead.
recipes.startdescription: From beneath the soil, the departed whisper curses. Whether I choose to obey or resist, to move forward, I will become no different from her. Then I answer her: even if death and snowfall are inevitable, for the sake of protecting something, I am willing to fight. Then the maiden points to my hand – how shall we dispose of this dead young serpent?
recipes.description: I look down. The dagger is long gone; curled in my palm is a dead young serpent. Beneath the soil, only a snake's nest. After a simple prayer, I bury it again.

recipes.label: Search the Wasteland?
recipes.startdescription: In this silent, desolate region, what will we find? And what will find us?

recipes.startdescription: The deeper we go, the dimmer the sun, the fiercer the earth trembles, and the more agitated the monsters become. This is the world's exposed skin, a place where waking and the Mansus should never have been linked.

slots.description: Where are we now? And where are we going?

recipes.startdescription:
We move back. I think it will take a few more days – we need to spend more time searching this bombarded, deserted wilderness for something.

[You lost progress.]

recipes.label: Under the Gaze of the Hour of Strife
recipes.startdescription: According to the ancient rules of the Lion-and-Mouse Duel, I am bound to hold the line, or else I will incur shame and annihilation. I shall remain here until I achieve victory or suffer defeat.

recipes.label: Too Remote?
recipes.startdescription: This location is beyond the wilderness; if I wish to reach it, I must set out from the wilderness itself.
